license_required.quote: a person may not engage in the public practice of geoscience unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: The Texas Board of Professional Geoscientists shall administer this chapter.

name.quote: The Texas Board of Professional Geoscientists shall administer this chapter.

type.quote: The Texas Board of Professional Geoscientists shall administer this chapter.

degree_required.value: graduated from a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board that consists of at least four years of study and includes at least 30 semester hours or 45 quarter hours of credit in geoscience
degree_required.quote: graduated from a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board that consists of at least four years of study and includes at least 30 semester hours or 45 quarter hours of credit in geoscience, of which at least 20 semester hours or 30 quarter hours of credit must be in upper-level college courses in that discipline

degree_level.quote: graduated from a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board that consists of at least four years of study

school_approval_basis.quote: a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board

credential_pegged.quote: graduated from a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board that consists of at least four years of study

required.quote: have a documented record of at least five years of qualifying work experience, as provided by Section 1002.256, that demonstrates that the applicant is qualified to assume responsible charge of geoscientific work

experience_source.quote: have a documented record of at least five years of qualifying work experience, as provided by Section 1002.256, that demonstrates that the applicant is qualified to assume responsible charge of geoscientific work

duration.quote: have a documented record of at least five years of qualifying work experience

kind.quote: qualifying work experience, as provided by Section 1002.256, that demonstrates that the applicant is qualified to assume responsible charge of geoscientific work

exams.name: examination covering the fundamentals and practice of the appropriate discipline of geoscience
exams.notes: The board may prepare its own exam or adopt a regional or national exam. The board retains authority to determine the passing grade.
exams.jurisdiction: national or regional (board may adopt exam prepared by another organization)
exams.quote: pass an examination required by the board covering the fundamentals and practice of the appropriate discipline of geoscience

interval_years.quote: A license is valid for a period not to exceed three years and expires according to a schedule established by board rule.

required.quote: As a condition for renewal of a license, the board may require each license holder to participate in continuing professional education on a periodic or other basis.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant who provides proof of licensure or registration under requirements that the board determines to be substantially similar to those established by this chapter and who pays the required fees.

requirements.value: Applicant must provide proof of licensure or registration in another state or foreign country under requirements substantially similar to Texas requirements, and pay required fees. The board may waive the examination requirement for such applicants.
requirements.quote: The board by rule may authorize the licensing of a person who has not met the examination requirement of Section 1002.255(a)(3) if the person is licensed or registered to practice a discipline of geoscience under the law of another state or a foreign country.

exists.quote: The Texas Board of Professional Geoscientists shall administer this chapter.

regulatory_model.quote: a person may not engage in the public practice of geoscience unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license to an applicant who meets the requirements of this chapter on payment of the applicable license fee.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not engage in the public practice of geoscience unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter

title_protection.quote: a person may not: (1) use the term "Licensed Professional Geoscientist" or the initials "P.G." as part of a professional, business, or commercial identification or title

scope_protection.quote: a person may not engage in the public practice of geoscience unless the person holds a license issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining a geoscience license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining a license as a geoscientist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, misconduct, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated negligence in the public practice of geoscience
disciplinary_grounds.quote: incompetence, misconduct, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated incidents of negligence in the public practice of geoscience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving moral turpitude or a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a license holder of a crime involving moral turpitude or a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imposition of an administrative, civil, or criminal penalty arising out of the public practice of geoscience
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the imposition of an administrative or civil penalty or a criminal fine, or imprisonment or probation instead of a fine, for a misdemeanor relating to or arising out of the public practice of geoscience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a cease and desist or similar sanction relating to the public practice of geoscience
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the issuance of a cease and desist order or a similar sanction relating to or arising out of the public practice of geoscience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using another's seal or allowing use of one's own seal on work not performed by or under the licensee's supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using the seal of another license holder or using or allowing the use of the license holder's seal on geoscientific work not performed by or under the supervision of the license holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting a person in a violation of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding or abetting a person in a violation of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, denial of renewal, or other disciplinary action by another licensing agency for geoscientists or a related profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the revocation or suspension of a license, the denial of renewal of a license, or other disciplinary action taken by a state agency, board of registration, or similar licensing agency for geoscientists or a profession or occupation related to the public practice of geoscience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or representing to the public that one is licensed or qualified to practice geoscience when not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or offering to practice geoscience or representing to the public that the person or the person's firm or corporation is licensed or qualified to practice geoscience if the person is not licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the chapter, rules adopted under it (including the code of professional conduct), or comparable provisions in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating this chapter, a rule adopted under this chapter, including the code of professional conduct, or a comparable provision of the laws or rules regulating the practice of geoscience in another state or country

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A firm or corporation may engage in the public practice of geoscience only if: (1) the geoscientific work is performed by, or under the supervision of, a licensed geoscientist who is in responsible charge of the work

definition_quote.value: the science of the earth and its origin and history, the investigation of the earth's environment and its constituent soils, rocks, minerals, fossil fuels, solids, and fluids, and the study of the natural and introduced agents, forces, and processes that cause changes in and on the earth
definition_quote.quote: "Geoscience" means the science of the earth and its origin and history, the investigation of the earth's environment and its constituent soils, rocks, minerals, fossil fuels, solids, and fluids, and the study of the natural and introduced agents, forces, and processes that cause changes in and on the earth.

methods_authorized.quote: "Public practice of geoscience" means the practice for the public of geoscientific services or work, including consulting, investigating, evaluating, analyzing, planning, mapping, and inspecting geoscientific work and the responsible supervision of those tasks.

tiered_registration_levels.quote: "Geoscientist in training" means a person registered by the board on the basis of education and who meets other requirements established by the board but who is not fully qualified to become a licensed geoscientist under this chapter.

approved_soils_curriculum_required.quote: graduated from a course of study in a discipline of geoscience satisfactory to the board

minimum_soil_science_credit_hours.quote: at least 30 semester hours or 45 quarter hours of credit in geoscience

teaching_or_research_counts_as_experienc.quote: The board may accept research in or the teaching of a discipline of geoscience at the college or university level as qualifying work experience if the research or teaching, in the judgment of the board, is comparable to work experience obtained in the practice of geoscience.

advanced_degree_experience_credit.quote: each year of full-time graduate study in a discipline of geoscience that is acceptable to the board constitutes one year of qualifying work experience

supervised_experience_required.quote: each year of work experience acceptable to the board constitutes one year of qualifying work experience if the experience was acquired under the direct supervision of: (A) a geoscientist who is licensed in this state or in another state

subordinate_definition_included.quote: geoscientific work performed by an employee or a subordinate of a license holder under this chapter if the work does not include the responsible charge of geoscientific work and is performed under the direct supervision of a licensed geoscientist who is responsible for the work

responsible_charge_definition_included.quote: "Responsible charge" means the independent control and direction of geoscientific work or the supervision of geoscientific work by the use of initiative, skill, and independent judgment.

firm_corporation_practice_allowed.quote: A firm or corporation may engage in the public practice of geoscience only if: (1) the geoscientific work is performed by, or under the supervision of, a licensed geoscientist who is in responsible charge of the work

firm_certificate_of_authorization_requir.quote: A firm that engages in the practice of both engineering and geoscience is exempt from any firm registration requirements created under this subsection.

nonresident_temporary_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a temporary license to a person who: (1) is not a resident of this state and does not have an established place of business in this state but who seeks to engage in the public practice of geoscience in this state for a temporary period

nonresident_practice_exempt_days.quote: A temporary license issued under Subsection (a)(1) expires on the 90th day after the date of issuance.

private_employer_exemption.quote: geoscientific work performed exclusively in exploring for and developing oil, gas, or other energy resources, base metals, or precious or nonprecious minerals, including sand, gravel, or aggregate, if the work is done in and for the benefit of private industry

seal_or_stamp_required_on_documents.quote: A geoscientific report, document, or other record, as defined by the board, that is offered to the public and prepared or issued by or under the supervision of a licensed geoscientist must, in accordance with rules adopted by the board, include the full name, signature, and license number of the license holder who prepared the report, document, or other record or under whose supervision it was prepared and bear an impression of the license holder's seal.

code_of_ethics_required.quote: The board by rule shall adopt a code of professional conduct that is binding on all license holders under this chapter.

board_includes_public_member.quote: Three members of the board must be members of the public.
